message: あだ名は着ぐるみ刑事

name: Misa
message: 「The patrol schedule is just as I explained. If anything happens, contact me immediately. Understood?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Too stiff, too stiff! Smile, smile! It's a festival, heave-ho!」

name: Misa
message: 「As if I could grin like an idiot in front of suspicious characters.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then how about beaming cheerfully instead?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's the exact same thing!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't panic, don't panic♪ Relax, relax♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you make a scary face like usual, the guests will run away.」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte? Do you actually realize what you're saying right now?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's why I found something great for our awkward Vice President and borrowed it!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't ignore me!!」

name: Misa
message: 「--Wait, th-th-this is...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A huge Paqy!!」

name: Ria
message: 「No, Nanaka. This is Blackuma. Paa-chan is a look-alike of this little guy.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah! You've got it all wrong, Ria! I was... here first... I'm the original, you know!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since it's actually sold as merchandise, it's far more useful than Mr. Panda.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, you little angel!! Step outside right now!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am not an angel, so I shall gracefully ignore that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, what're we gonna do with this?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wear it, of course.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And \{who|\s12\s12\s12} exactly is gonna do that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Vice President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, that might actually be a great idea. Though, Misa... walking around in a mascot suit as a girl is a bit--」

name: Misa
message: 「This is my chance!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?!」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No, no. It's nothing.」

name: Misa
message: 「I had secretly had my eye on it, so this couldn't have turned out better.」

name: Misa
message: 「Very well. I just need to wear that and stand guard, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nice, nice! Now it's really starting to feel like a festival!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, it's going to be really tough... If anyone's doing it, I should--」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't underestimate me. Anything you can do, I can pull off effortlessly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa-chan. Give us a greeting, please♪」

name: Misa
message: 「Ahh... Body and soul, I am Blackuma...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Misa... chan?」

name: Misa
message: 「It's just like being inside a picture book... How wonderful...\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa! Misa! The greeting, the greeting!」

name: Misa
message: 「Kukuku... Oh, pardon the intrusion.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Getting into character, obviously.」

name: Synn
message: 「With this, we're completely set. The peace of the academy is as good as ours!」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, that's not entirely true~」

name: Synn
message: 「Is there some kind of problem?」

name: Ria
message: 「I mean, don't you think it's hard to move in an outfit like that, so she wouldn't be able to catch any suspicious people?」

name: Ria
message: 「Which. Is. Why. You'll have to support her properly, Synn-kun\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Kuma?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, the Shooting Star Kirakira Festival is about to begin!」

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's do our best today too!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, let's start around the entrance first.」

name: Misa
message: 「Why are you the one calling the shots?!」

name: Synn
message: 「You can't talk like your usual self, Misa. Don't ruin the kids' dreams!」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go, Blackuma. Eat this and keep up the good work\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「Kukuku... Oh, thank you kindly.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, I'm heading off to club activities now. I'll leave the rest to you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Understood.」

name: Ria
message: 「Make sure you take good care of her and lead the way\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「You got this!」
H-how am I supposed to take the lead?!
First, let's check the entrance to make sure there aren't any suspicious people.
While keeping an eye on our surroundings, we also hand out balloons.
This is where Blackuma comes in.

name: Synn
message: 「Here. I'll hand you the balloons, so please pass them out.」

name: Misa
message: 「Kukuku... Oh, thanks very much.」
All sorts of visitors, young and old, men and women, stream in one after another.

name: Misa
message: 「Kukuku... Balloons aren't so bad once in a while.」

name: Boy
message: 「Whoa! It's Blackuma!」

name: Girl
message: 「So cute\s04」
Oh, looks like it's already a huge hit.

name: Boy
message: 「Kick it, kick it!」

name: Girl
message: 「Hey, hey. Give me a hug!」
Perhaps it's the fate of a mascot suit, but it gets showered with more affection than necessary.
Kids repeatedly kick the fluffy parts or tackle it wanting to be pampered.
Kids really have no mercy.
Hang in there, Misa. Don't get mad.

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone, poor Blackuma's had enough, so let's call it there, okay~」

name: Boy
message: 「Aww」

name: Girl
message: 「No way, no way~」
Blackuma stepped boldly forward, blocking me from view.

name: Misa
message: 「Kukuku... Getting all worked up won't get you anywhere, pal」

name: Boy
message: 「Hahaha, it's just like him~」
How should I put it--she's just like Paqy.

name: Girl
message: 「Yay, so fluffy~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Are you okay?」
She tries to nod eagerly, but the chin of the costume gets in the way so she can't quite manage it.
She's probably trying to say something like, 'Something like this is no big deal at all.'

name: Synn
message: 「Blackuma says he's giving everyone balloons!」

name: Boy
message: 「Gimme one!」

name: Girl
message: 「Thank you~~」

name: Sally
message: 「I'll take one too while you're at it, thanks~\s04」

name: Boy
message: 「Daaad. That Blackuma looks just like the real thing~」

name: Girl
message: 「And when he talks, he goes 'kukuku' just right~」
Amazing, Misa. I don't really know the original, but she's passing muster with the true connoisseurs.
I feel like I could pull off a Paqy impression, though...

name: Misa
message: 「Kukuku...」
There's no way I could imitate this adorable brand of evil.

name: Synn
message: 「Blackuma. Does everyone love you~?」

name: Girl
message: 「I love him~」

name: Boy
message: 「I like Lil' Blackuma. The way he goes 'zz-kew!' with the psycho gun on his right arm is super cool」
There's a whole lot going on with this character, huh.

name: Girl
message: 「Hey, can I unzip the zipper?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kukuku... Please, anything but that」

name: Boy
message: 「I knew it, there's striped fabric inside!」

name: Synn
message: 「Stripes, huh~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, how do you know about that, kid!?」

name: Boy
message: 「Everyone knows. Right?」

name: Girl
message: 「Right♪」
M-Misa... Is your underwear situation not a shameful secret, but common knowledge to the entire neighborhood!?

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... W-Wha!?」
Taking advantage of my flustered state, Blackuma swayed and toppled right over toward me.

name: Misa
message: 「Hehehe... Please, make yourself at home」

name: Synn
message: 「Mgh」

name: Boy
message: 「What a spoiled baby~」

name: Girl
message: 「No fair~. I wanna laze around like that too~」
Wh-Wha!? What's going on all of a sudden? Misa just pinned me down!?

name: Misa
message: 「The striped fabric is just because Blackuma is a mysterious creature like that--it has nothing to do with my underwear at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... Did you do this just to tell me that?」

name: Misa
message: 「Got it!?」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Got it」

name: Boy
message: 「Big bro and Blackuma are lovey-dovey~」

name: Girl
message: 「Lazing around, lovey-dovey~\s04」
Come to think of it, I'm hugging Misa while she's inside a mascot suit.
Well, to onlookers, it probably just looks like a bear and a human getting along.
Even so, what's embarrassing is embarrassing!

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, we need to separate soon...」
Inside the mascot suit, Misa seems to be struggling with something.

name: Misa
message: 「S-Sorry... Just for a little while... stay like this, please」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「My legs...」
There's no strength in her lower body. Could it be--

name: Synn
message: 「Did you get a cramp?」

name: Misa
message: 「Shh!!」

name: Synn
message: 「But--」

name: Misa
message: 「There's even an episode where Blackuma gets a leg cramp, so... it's fine, so...」
Is that really the issue here!?

name: Girl
message: 「Hey, what's wrong?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kukuku... Even a pinch will come to an end eventually」
Since she leaned against me so suddenly, she probably pulled it in the process.
Even I have my hands full just supporting Misa's limp body and the weight of the mascot costume.
If I could just get a little help holding her up, I could regain my footing and carry her, though...
Misa might get mad at me if I do that, but I can't just leave her like this either.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, hold on a second, you two...」

name: Boy
message: 「Let's go over there~」

name: Girl
message: 「Bye-bye. Kukuku... take your time」
S-Someone~~\s01

name: Shio
message: 「Truly touch-and-go, a close call indeed. Had I not been here, it would have turned into a catastrophe by now」
That's Shio-chan, who initially charged in thinking Blackuma was a thug. Or rather, the fact that I'm the one being attacked by a thug... sigh.

name: Shio
message: 「Dear Sister, when we are somewhere deserted like this, why not take off that headpiece?」

name: Misa
message: 「Not Dear Sister, Blackuma!!」

name: Shio
message: 「F-Forgive me. Lord Blackuma」

name: Synn
message: 「Wouldn't it be suffocating if you don't at least show your face?」

name: Misa
message: 「How could I possibly take it off when we don't know who might be where? I don't want to ruin the children's dreams」

name: Shio
message: 「However, if you remain like that, you will be regarded as one of the monsters」

name: Paqy
message: 「One of my kind...?」

name: Synn
message: 「She might actually be hoping for that, surprisingly」

name: Synn
message: 「Silence」

name: Shio
message: 「She has fallen silent.」

name: Paqy
message: 「She just doesn't wanna strip, that's all.」

name: Man
message: 「Where might the fair maiden be?」

name: Misa
message: 「Kuma?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sir, the venue is over that way.」

name: Man
message: 「Pardon me. I have wandered astray in romance, lost in the labyrinth of love.」

name: Shio
message: 「He speaks most strangely.」

name: Man
message: 「A Yamato Nadeshiko. You appear to possess magnificent potential, my lady. However, it seems we must wait a little longer for you to fully ripen.」

name: Shio
message: 「What did you say?!」

name: Man
message: 「While there is merit in savoring the tartness of unripe fruit...」

name: Shio
message: 「H-How insolent!! Kneel right where you stand!!」

name: Man
message: 「Despite appearances, I am not one to compromise. I shall yearn patiently until the time is right.」

name: Shio
message: 「I said kneel!! Compose yourself and accept your punishment!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, calm down, Shio-chan\s01」

name: Man
message: 「Well, well, what have we here...」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What is it?」

name: Man
message: 「Might I have the honor of asking your name?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sakura--」

name: Man
message: 「Miss Sakura. What a ravishing name.」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Miss?」

name: Man
message: 「You are a woman blessed with beauty befitting such a name, Miss Sakura.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, I'm actually a guy.」

name: Man
message: 「Please forgive my discourtesy. I was simply bewitched by your allure, which stirs the very instincts within me.」
Even though I'm being praised, it's a huge shock when it's coming from a guy.

name: Man
message: 「Now then... It appears you are the last one remaining.」

name: Man
message: 「You are truly my woman of destiny.」

name: Misa
message: 「Kuma?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... You can't even tell if that's a male or female bear, though.」

name: Man
message: 「Rest assured. My eyes never deceive me. Never before today have I found a bear so endearing and adorable.」
Is he being serious, or just saying this on purpose? He's a hard guy to read.

name: Man
message: 「Princess Bear. Let us embark on a journey of elopement together.」
No sooner had he said that than he wrapped an arm around Blackuma's waist and pulled her close.

name: Misa
message: 「H-H-Hey, stop that, please!」

name: Man
message: 「Grope, grope.」
The hand wrapped around her waist is fondling Misa's butt.

name: Shio
message: 「Sister--no, what are you doing to Lord Blackuma?! Unhand her!! Otherwise--」
Without even saying what she'll do, Shio readies her naginata and charges forward.

name: Man
message: 「Excuse me...」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio!!」
Brushing back his bangs, he effortlessly dodged Shio's fierce assault.

name: Shio
message: 「Grrr, you insolent fiend... Get away from my sister at once!!」

name: Man
message: 「Obstacles are part and parcel of love, aren't they? Grope, grope.」

name: Misa
message: 「Eek?!」

name: Shio
message: 「Why yoooou! Prepare to face--」

name: Synn
message: 「Stop it!」
Cutting off the raging Shio, before I knew it, I had lunged forward and grabbed the man's wrist tightly.

name: Synn
message: 「If you do anything else she doesn't like, I won't forgive you!」

name: Man
message: 「Won't forgive me, you say... Just what do you intend to do to me?」

name: Misa
message: 「...Wanna know? This!」
Misa kicked the man square in the groin with her mascot costume foot.

name: Misa
message: 「Now then, one groper apprehended. I'm hauling him down to headquarters.」

name: Man
message: 「...Rest assured. I have no intention of running or hiding」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, if that's the case... I suppose it's fine」

name: Man
message: 「I am not without tact, you know. Had you simply told me so from the start...」

name: Misa
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Man
message: 「I mean that the two of you are lovers」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「L-Lovers...?」

name: Shio
message: 「Sir Synn, Elder Sister... Are you saying you exchanged m-m-marital vows behind my back!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Wh-Wha--Shio, what on earth are you saying!? That's obviously a lie!!」

name: Man
message: 「May fortune shine upon your future together. Excuse me」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, hey, wait a second!!」

name: Man
message: 「To speak of love with fair maidens, not a single moment can be spared. I cannot allow my precious time to be interrupted」
The man conceals himself in a flurry of rose petals, vanishing like a puff of smoke.
Or so I thought--he was actually just running away hunched over. It must have hurt pretty bad after all.

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go after him!」

name: Misa
message: 「Right!」

name: Misa
message: 「Aah!?」
The massive body beside me nosedives into the ground, its detached head rolling away.
Come to think of it, Misa was wearing a mascot costume.

name: Misa
message: 「Go... Don't worry about me, just hurry and go!!」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Got it!」

name: Misa
message: 「Please!!」

name: Man
message: 「It seems I let the festival atmosphere go to my head. I shall be more careful in the future. Farewell, young Student Council President」

name: Synn
message: 「Fareweeeell~~」
With this, peace had finally returned.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy. That guy just now... he was definitely a demon, wasn't he」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good eye」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. At this point, I just assume all weirdos are demons」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's a terrible misconception. Though, I suppose the Demon Lord is included in that group too」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey. The walls have ears, so that topic is off-limits」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me, Sakura-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!」
The refreshing scent of soap.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, welcome back, Misa. I caught them and gave them a proper warning, just like you asked」

name: Misa
message: 「I see. Only natural for my rival. So, where are they?」

name: Synn
message: 「Not here」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「They already went home」

name: Misa
message: 「Did you make sure to clear things up with them?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I gave them a good talking-to about not sexually harassing people」

name: Misa
message: 「That's it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Misa
message: 「Then that means they still have the wrong idea!!」

name: Synn
message: 「About what?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, phew. About us being married!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ohh, ahh」

name: Misa
message: 「I already explained things to Shio myself, but... that person from earlier still has the wrong idea!!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's fine. Because that person... never saw what you actually look like, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh... now that you mention it, that's true」

name: Synn
message: 「They just think me and Blackuma are married, that's all」

name: Misa
message: 「No way!! That still completely counts as having the wrong idea!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa... You're going out of your way to worry about that for my sake~!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't be ridiculous. Blackuma doesn't belong to anyone.」

name: Synn
message: 「So it's about that.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Cold-hearted.」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, still... thank you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Just to be clear, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, you did ask me to, Misa. It'd be scary if I didn't catch them properly, ahahaha.」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-That's not what I meant...」

name: Misa
message: 「~~~! Hurry up, we're getting back to patrol!! Just you watch, I'll catch them myself this time!」
Even after taking off the mascot costume, I ended up doing security patrol together with Misa.
